appDescription: The closing stage of Ostkustleden runs from the remote Hällveberg cabin back to Lilla Hycklinge. The route descends through forest toward Virån, crosses and follows the river, passes Åmötsberget and the Stensjö by cultural reserve, then continues through pasture, tractor roads, narrow forest paths and a road stretch toward Skrikebo. Near the end it passes Björkelund, Nybo göl and pine forest before reaching the village road into Hycklinge and the Lilla Hycklinge cabin. The official GPX is navigation-grade only after sequencing its track pieces and removing duplicate slivers.

camping: Hällveberg and Lilla Hycklinge use the general Ostkustleden cabin/tenting fee pattern: 100 SEK/person in cabin and 50 SEK/person tenting by cabin, where allowed.
Stensjö by rules prohibit tenting in fenced grazing land.
Cabins are intended for Ostkustleden hikers; group/currentness should be verified before publication.
fire: No outdoor fires at Hällveberg cabin.
Lilla Hycklinge has a concrete grill ring/fireplace, but only if no fire ban or stricter rule applies.
Stensjö by permits fires only at designated places.
Oskarshamn fire-ban page showed no fire ban on 2026-04-29, but same-day fire-risk/current local status must be rechecked.
toilets: Hällveberg has a simple dry toilet on/near the cabin yard; no separate coordinate found.
Stensjö by has importable toilet coordinate from OSM/service context.
Lilla Hycklinge has toilet in nearby building; no separate coordinate found.

closuresAndReroutes.notes: No closure or reroute found on checked official pages. Naturkartan Ostkustleden news had no news items and Länsstyrelsen Stensjö by had no current visitor news.

protectedAreas.name: Kulturreservatet Stensjö by
rulesSummary: Confirmed route-relevant: Etapp 8 passes through the cultural reserve.
No tenting in fenced grazing land.
Do not damage living/dead trees or shrubs.
Do not deliberately disturb livestock or wild animals.
Permits required for signs/markers, competitions/organized events, collecting certain mosses/lichens/fungi/plants/insects and drone use.
Marked trails pass through areas grazed by cows or sheep; close gates.

protectedAreas.name: Virån / Viråns vattensystem Natura 2000 context
rulesSummary: Naturkartan identifies Virån as a species-rich watercourse within Natura 2000 context.
Stensjö by reserve rules reference Natura 2000 and conservation measures for Virån.
Exact Natura 2000 boundary intersection should be GIS-confirmed before import.
protectedAreas.importCaveat: Do not apply detailed Natura 2000 boundary rules until GIS overlay confirms intersection.

dogs.summary: Stensjö by requires leashed dogs/pets year-round. General Swedish March 1-August 20 wildlife-control rule also applies elsewhere.

grazingAndLivestock.summary: Stensjö by marked trails pass through cattle/sheep grazing areas. Close gates, avoid disturbing animals and keep dogs leashed.

hunting.summary: Naturkartan Etapp 8 carries elk-hunting notice October 8-January 31. On access date 2026-04-29 the stated period was not active. Model as seasonal safety note, not current closure.

fire.summary: Oskarshamn page showed no municipal fire ban at access date, but fire-risk and local fire-ban status are highly time-sensitive. Hällveberg forbids outdoor fires, Stensjö by allows fires only at designated places and Lilla Hycklinge grill ring use depends on no active fire ban.

roadSafety.summary: Route includes gravel roads, some asphalt, a stretch toward Skrikebo and village road through Hycklinge. Field report also described access/wrong-turn extra distance and a steep rope-assisted descent near Virån.

waterSafety.summary: Hällveberg well should be boiled/treated. Stensjö by water refill is guide-supported but not separately verified as a potable-water coordinate. Lilla Hycklinge has water in the house. Nybo göl has steep shores and very deep water warning.

forestry.summary: No official current forestry-work or reroute notice found for Etapp 8. Stensjö by reserve management can involve maintenance, grazing, conservation work and controlled burning, so temporary local signage remains possible.

conditionReports.summary: Recent users report generally very good conditions, low traffic, insects in late July and good cabins. One 2025 review says AllTrails route geometry is old and can diverge from actual markings; older 2022 comments mention tough trail, missing yellow marks on at least one section and need for GPS/map-reading.

conditionReports.summary: Direct report of Etapp 8: extra distance due to road-barrier access and wrong turns, searching for yellow markings, brushy/narrow sections, ankle-twisting footing, hungry insects, gravel roads, some asphalt and steep descent near Virån with rope aid.
conditionReports.notes: Useful terrain/route-finding evidence, not a current maintenance notice.

sourceContradictions.summary: Current Naturkartan display uses Hällveberg, but URL/GPX filename and OSM relation use Hedvigsberg. Hällveberg cabin page reconciles this by stating Hedvigsberg is the older name and Hällveberg is current on maps. Döderhult also contains Hälveberg spelling in places.
sourceContradictions.impact: Use Hällveberg as display/canonical endpoint and Hedvigsberg/Hälveberg as aliases/source spellings.

sourceContradictions.summary: Naturkartan says 16.9 km, normalized GPX computes about 16.834 km, PDF/Oskarshamn round to 17 km, OSM computes about 16.76 km but tags 18 km, and Döderhult says cirka 18 km.
sourceContradictions.impact: Use 16.9 km canonical; record 17 km as rounded official and 18 km as older/rounded maintainer/OSM tag.

sourceContradictions.summary: Official GPX contains eight pieces, but raw order creates jumps and duplicate sliver tracks 2 and 7. Correct sequence is 8 -> 4 -> 3 -> 1 -> 5R -> 6R.
sourceContradictions.impact: Do not import raw GPX order. Normalize exactly as documented.

sourceContradictions.summary: Naturkartan Etapp 8 Hitta hit/stage marker is mid-route, not start or endpoint.
sourceContradictions.impact: Do not use the stage marker for endpoint coordinates.

sourceContradictions.summary: Normalized official GPX endpoint is 156.4 m from the Lilla Hycklinge cabin marker, while the official description says the section ends at the trail entrance/overnight cabin.
sourceContradictions.impact: Keep this as endpoint/access caveat; do not auto-snap the route to cabin without separate access-leg evidence.

sourceContradictions.summary: Naturkartan says Kungliga Vitterhetsakademien acquired Stensjö by in 1963, while Döderhult says owned since 1960.
